title: Part sale line lookup does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSLOOK-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL PSLOOK PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-A} (for example P2-89) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL PSLOOK Customer) is open and has no parts.
  • Before {Part-A} was set inactive, typing the start of its number in the part sale's Add Part lookup offered it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-sale-A} and its Parts tab.
  2. Click "Add Part".
  3. Type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSL) in Part Number.
  4. Close the part row without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 4: {Part-sale-A} still has no parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-R8, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: board 6.7 shows a part sale but not its part lookup. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R8: “Part lookup on a part sale line does not return inactive parts.”
  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given GREASETUBE is inactive, when the user searches "GREASE" on a work order, estimate, part sale, purchase order or technician charge-out, then it is not offered, neither as an inventory part nor as a Part Library entry.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7, ListingQueryHandler: “Covers WO, estimate, tech charge-out (every device), PO, vendor-bill re-point, part sale”
